hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])git[[:space:]]+(commit|push|tag)([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[^[:alnum:]_])git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard'; then echo 'BLOCKED by Constitution Article I: never run git commit/push/tag/force-push/reset --hard without an explicit user request in this conversation. Ask the user first.' >&2; exit 2; fi

i=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); b=$(basename "$fp"); case "$b" in .env.example|.env.sample|.env.template|.env.dist) ;; .env|.env.*) echo "BLOCKED by Constitution Article II: do not write secrets to $b. Configuration belongs in environment variables; document each one in .env.example with placeholder values only." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; case "$fp" in *.md|*.mdx|*.example|*.sample|*.template) exit 0 ;; esac; ct=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // .tool_input.new_string // ""'); if printf '%s' "$ct" | grep -qE 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}'; then echo 'BLOCKED by Constitution Article II: this content matches a real credential format (AWS / GitHub / Slack / Stripe / Google / PEM private key). Never put secrets in the repo; load them from environment variables.' >&2; exit 2; fi

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // ""'); case "$fp" in *.ts|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$fp"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$d" != "." ]; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then if grep -q '"lint"' "$d/package.json" 2>/dev/null; then (cd "$d" && pnpm run lint 2>&1; pnpm run typecheck 2>&1) || true; fi; break; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exit 0
